threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look lost when the bus arrives and you have to figure out if it's going to Stoke Newington or Dalston. We've all been there.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last weekend; a guy was trying to sell homemade sandwiches. Said they were 'artisan' but looked more like leftovers from a pub crawl.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw two guys arguing over the best kebab place while sipping mate by the canal. That’s pure Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you accidentally stumble upon a 24-hour Späti disco with a line of locals waiting for their turn to dance on a Wednesday night.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s from here by how they react to BART delays—locals just roll their eyes and pull out a book, while newcomers panic.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: The bus driver just legit stopped mid-ride to scold a guy for blasting music. Only in the TL do you get a full concert and a lecture at 8 AM.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the plazas, but the real vibe is in the narrow streets where locals sip coffee and laugh at the noise of the world.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still awkwardly pausing at street corners, trying to navigate the one-way systems while looking at their phone maps.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep saying 'the Tube' instead of just 'my train' like everyone else. Get ready for the side-eye at the bus stop.
Caught a lad on the 59 last night practicing his stand-up. Told a joke about the Tube strikes; half the bus laughed, half groaned. Welcome to Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted the old lady feeding pigeons at Hermannplatz while chatting with a street musician. That mixture of everyday chaos felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a late-night Döner place with a bouncer. It's like clubbing but for kebabs. No shortage of character here!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local if they still call it ‘the 16th’ and not ‘the 16th Street Mission’ when talking about the BART station.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 today with a goat on a leash. Turns out it's a local mascot. Only in SF do you ride with a goat and hear a saxophonist on the next stop.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's squares are just for lounging, but locals use them for the best impromptu concerts and spontaneous dance-offs.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a new arrival by their struggle with the bicicleta shortcuts; locals glide through while they’re still consulting Google Maps on every corner.
